Create a table of most frequent taxa in a data.frame

Source: R/describe_curation.R
createTaxonTable.Rd

For each of the top taxa, counts how often it was reported increased vs. decreased and runs a binomial test on those counts (null: 50/50).

Usage

createTaxonTable(dat, n = 10, format = "Simple")

Arguments

dat

data.frame produced by importBugSigDB, subsetted as desired

n

number of taxa to return (if sig.type=="both", this is the number of taxa to return for each direction)

format

"Simple" (default) keeps only the core summary columns; any other value returns the full table, with those columns moved to the front

Value

a data.frame with one row per taxon, giving its taxonomic level, total/increased/decreased signature counts, and binomial test p-value. Can be wrapped in kable_styling(kbl(...)) to format nicely.

Examples

full.dat <- bugsigdbr::importBugSigDB()
#> Using cached version from 2026-11-09 16:28:46
createTaxonTable(full.dat, n=20)
